en.hubeali:
And by this chain, 
‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘
Whatever Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Opens upon a servant (from) the door of gratefulness, He<sup>azwj</sup> does not Keep the door of increasing (bounties) hidden from him’.
en.sarwar: 2. It is narrated through the same chain of narrators: “The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘
Whenever Allah opens the door of gratitude to someone He does not keep the door of increasing (bounties) hidden from him.’”
